messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to pull that data directly from an external source right now. However, I can give you a quick rundown of Canada’s statutory holidays in 2023 that typically create long weekends:

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Typical Long‑Weekend Impact |
|---------|-------------|-------------|----------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sunday | Weekend only |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Friday | 3‑day weekend |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Saturday | Weekend only |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Thursday) | Thursday | 2‑day weekend (if observed on Friday) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Monday | 3‑day weekend |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tuesday | 2‑day weekend |

If you need the exact dates for each province or want to confirm which holidays are statutory in your specific region, let me know and I can help you look up the official provincial calendars!
